description: Angular component for configuring map item tooltips with dynamic form controls based on map item type.

classes.name: MapItemTooltipsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for map item tooltips configuration.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updates validators when mapItemType changes.

methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.description: Sets the component's value and updates form controls accordingly.
